text:
The builder is likely to recover $14,000: expectation damages of $20,000 contract price minus $5,000 remaining cost to complete minus $1,000 saved on resold materials, since stopping work was a breach and the builder is entitled to profits plus costs incurred. The resale of unused materials offsets recovery, but the partially built greenhouse’s $3,000 added value does not limit the builder’s damages.  
CONFIDENCE: 82
